description: Source code for an IO timer source class that manages timer file descriptors, starts/stops timer ticking, and handles timer expirations within a network support library.

classes.name: io_timer_source
classes.description: A class managing a timer file descriptor, scheduling timer ticks, and integrating with a network broker.

methods.name: create_timer_fd
methods.description: Creates and configures a timer file descriptor with a specified tick period.

methods.name: io_timer_source::io_timer_source
methods.description: Constructor initializing the timer source with parameters and optionally auto-starting.

methods.name: io_timer_source::~io_timer_source
methods.description: Destructor that requests stopping the timer source.

methods.name: io_timer_source::resume
methods.description: Starts the timer ticking if not already running.

methods.name: io_timer_source::request_stop
methods.description: Requests to stop the timer ticking.

methods.name: io_timer_source::create_subscriber
methods.description: Creates a subscriber for the timer fd and registers it with the broker.

methods.name: io_timer_source::destroy_subscriber
methods.description: Destroys the subscriber and unregisters the fd.

methods.name: io_timer_source::read_time
methods.description: Reads timer expirations and triggers tick sink accordingly.
